in_sanskrit.name: Raqesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Raqesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ruler of Wealth and Prosperity, One who is the Master of Fortune

in_tamil.name: Raqesh
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Ruler of Wealth
in_tamil.long_meaning: Raqesh ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Ruler of Wealth and Prosperity, One who is the Master of Fortune

in_telugu.name: Raqesh
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Ruler of Wealth
in_telugu.long_meaning: Raqesh ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Ruler of Wealth and Prosperity, One who is the Master of Fortune

in_marathi.name: Raqesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raqesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ruler of Wealth and Prosperity, One who is the Master of Fortune

in_bengali.name: Raqesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Ruler of Wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Raqesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ruler of Wealth and Prosperity, One who is the Master of Fortune
